content.text:
The university moved from uni_owns_option_to_licence but kept exclusivity at 12 months (down from our 18). We want company_owns. Let me trade: accept uni_owns_option_to_assign (stronger than option_to_licence, gives us path to ownership) and push exclusivity back to 18 months. Or accept the IP position and push exclusivity to 18 months.

I can only change at most two fields. Let me change ip to uni_owns_option_to_assign and exclusivity months to 18.
